name: std::swap(std::unordered_multimap)

declarations.code:
template <class Key, class T, class Hash, class KeyEqual, class Alloc>

void swap(std::unordered_multimap<Key, T, Hash, KeyEqual, Alloc> &lhs,

    std::unordered_multimap<Key, T, Hash, KeyEqual, Alloc> &rhs)

    noexcept(/* see below */);

intro: Specializes the std::swap algorithm for std::unordered_multimap. Swaps the contents of lhs and rhs. Calls lhs.swap(rhs).
